purpose: Teach: 部首/肉食/賢者/胃腸/貧富/剰余/分娩/既知

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、漢方の部首的分類を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Ren, we reference kampo herbal classification within the medical team's framework.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady eye contact. Measured pace that conveys competence without coldness. The tone of someone sharing clinical practice, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 肉食偏重の食生活を、貴院、指導されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does guide patients away from meat-heavy diets, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with underlying respect. Slight pause before the question tag — he's truly listening, not performing. Soft but engaged.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療現場で賢者になる事より謙虚さを医療チームで重視します
lines.en: Yes. In the medical setting, we prioritize humility over the appearance of expertise within the team.
lines.style: Patient, unhurried delivery. Slight emphasis on 'humility' — not defensive, but making a quiet point. The tone of someone who has thought about this carefully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 胃腸疾患の患者を、貴院、丁寧に診られますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does examine gastric patients with such care, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Admiration tempered with genuine question. Deliberate pace. He's noticing something real and checking his own observation. Not flattering — witnessing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、貧富に関わらず平等な医療を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes. We provide equal medical care regardless of patients' economic circumstances within our team.
lines.style: Steady, unadorned statement. No inflection that suggests pride. The matter-of-factness of someone stating principle, not performance. Clear finish.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 剰余在庫の医薬品を、貴院、適切に管理されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does manage surplus medication inventory properly, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Curious but genuinely asking. Lighter touch than the previous questions. He's moved from observing care to observing operations. Slightly more open, less formal.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、無痛分娩を医療チームで安全に提供します
lines.en: Yes. We provide pain-free childbirth safely within the medical team's protocols.
lines.style: Clear, clinical. A slight warmth on 'safely' — acknowledging the human stakes without sentimentality. Composed finish. Professional but human.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 既知の合併症を、貴院、患者に説明されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does explain known complications to patients beforehand, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Quieter here — almost trailing into reflection. The final question feels more introspective. Still respectful, but like he's reaching the limit of what he came to ask. Gentler attack.
